text:
maria: ran a quick local smoke for bringing up a quantized model with the eval harness, CI notification didn't fire and the runner hung after `starting worker`
aj: ugh, seen that before with the new quant path, can you paste the tail of the log?
maria: sure — here's the chunk:
```
INFO starting worker 0
INFO model loaded: vicuna-1.1-q4_0
WARN prefix cache miss
ERROR hanging on kv-cache flush? waiting for lock
```
lee: that ERROR looks familiar — there was a race in the local runner when prefix-cache is enabled + `--dryrun`. it blocks on flush and never posts status to the notify hook
sam: is this the same as the CI flakes where the github action times out but still reports success later?
maria: similar symptom. on my machine GH action never ran (I used `devex/local-run --ci-simulate`) — no webhook call to the `ci-bot` channel, no artifact upload
infra-bot: note: deploy hooks will not run if runner.process exits with code 143 (SIGTERM) — check runner logs for exit code
nora: quick mitigation: set `EVAL_LOCAL_PREFIX_CACHE=false` in env when doing local quant smoke tests. avoids the flush path. not a fix but helps unblock debugging :pray:
aj: long-term fix: I'll add a timeout on the prefix-cache flush + explicit health ping to the notify webhook. That should ensure CI sees at least a heartbeat before the hang
maria: thanks. also the CLI UX here is bad — `--ci-simulate` doesn't print the simulate webhook payload, so it's hard to debug what the CI would see
lee: agreed. proposal: `devex/local-run --ci-simulate --verbose-payload` prints the exact JSON and posts a dry-run to `ci-bot` with `dry_run: true`. saves a round trip to GH actions
sam: and while we're at it, the exit codes from `local-run` are inconsistent: 0 on partial failure sometimes. we should map outcomes to well-defined codes (0=ok, 1=fail, 2=skipped, 3=internal-error)
ci-bot: FYI — we'll add a `dry-run` annotation to messages so `#devex` can filter real vs simulated posts
maria: I'll open a small PR for docs + a quickfix env var change, and add the log snippet to the issue. want to capture the exact steps to reproduce with a quant model and local checkout
aj: please cc me. I'll work on the timeout/health ping patch and add unit tests covering the prefix-cache path
nora: I'll add a short note in the README under "Local runs -> CI debugging" with the env var workaround and example commands
maria: sample commands I'm using: `git checkout feature/quant-smoke && devex/local-run --model vicuna-1.1-q4_0 --ci-simulate --dryrun`
lee: can someone confirm the sample reproduces on mac/linux? sometimes the lock semantics differ
maria: repros on linux (WSL) for me, haven't tested mac
sam: ok let's track the followups: 1) PR for timeout + health ping (aj) 2) README snippet (nora) 3) CLI flag `--verbose-payload` (lee) 4) short-term env var workaround doc + issue link (maria)
aj: targeting a small PR today, will tag reviewers
maria: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
